_scenarios: The bank priced this deal two ways. Files 8 and 9 each exist in a CompPay (comprehensive payables, includes virtual card) and a PM Only (Paymode Connect, no card) variant. The converted tab is identical in both; they diverge in the card program. The workspace exposes this as a scenario switch.
_paymentTypeMap: BofA sends its own payment-type codes rather than the model's vocabulary. This map was read back out of the delivered workbook (VHF column E vs column AK), not invented: ACH 1160, SWIFT 168, INT 118, PAID_MAN 41, D_WIRE 29.
_vhfOverrides: Reviewer decisions applied to the vendor hit file after the reviewed pricing output is pasted in. None have been derived for this deal yet — deriving them requires diffing a generated workbook against the delivered one, as was done for JPM.
_bookingAssumptions: Per-deal enrollment-rate assumptions the pricing analyst sets by hand on the hidden 'Booking Calc' tab. Not yet derived for this deal; leaving this empty means the workbook keeps whatever the template carries rather than having invented rates written into it.
